title: User arrival and auth surfaces: landing, sign-in, sign-out, expiry, recovery, onboarding, and deep-link redirects
description: The application ships designed surfaces for: first-visit unauthenticated landing, sign-in, sign-out confirmation, session-expired, forgot-password, account-recovery, and first-run onboarding. Deep links visited while unauthenticated redirect to sign-in and return the user to the originally requested route after successful authentication.
rationale: Arrival and auth surfaces are the first and the worst-tested screens in most applications. Specifying them as first-class surfaces stops them shipping as afterthoughts.
